## File: facebookresearch_mephisto/test/abstractions/providers/prolific/test_prolific_utils.py

Prompts

```
['create a Prolific study with title, description, reward, and eligibility requirements via the API', 'publish a Prolific study to make it live or stop an active study early', 'pay a bonus to a Prolific worker by checking balance and submitting a bonus payment', 'block or unblock a Prolific worker by adding or removing them from a participant group', 'approve or reject a Prolific worker submission after reviewing its status and content']
```

Usage

```
{'create_prolific_study': 'create a Prolific study with title, description, reward, and eligibility requirements via the API', 'publish_and_stop_study': 'publish a Prolific study to make it live or stop an active study early', 'pay_worker_bonus': 'pay a bonus to a Prolific worker by checking balance and submitting a bonus payment', 'block_or_unblock_worker': 'block or unblock a Prolific worker by adding or removing them from a participant group', 'approve_or_reject_submission': 'approve or reject a Prolific worker submission after reviewing its status and content'}
```
